name: cobol-lexer-literal-and-period-limits
body: The lexer reads X"..." as a word followed by an alphanumeric literal, treats column-7 'D' lines as comments, and keeps a '.' inside any word when a non-space follows (so X.) stays one word). A continued literal without its opening quote reports a generic unterminated literal. Limit: hexadecimal literals and debugging lines are not modelled. Upgrade when a dialect or corpus needs hex literals, debugging mode or finer period rules.
